what: The pinned hero is split into left and right halves, with photos stacked in each half. At each step (1.1 screens of scroll, with scrub over 1 of those screens), the top photo peels away — upward on the left, downward on the right (clip-path inset 0 → 100%) — revealing the next photo. On the last step, each half-panel peels away in the same direction to show the section behind, and the two lines of vertical title in the center slide out in opposite directions by one screen each (−100vh·+100vh). Tied to scroll (no curve), so scrolling back covers it again

options.step: Gap between steps (in screens), default 1.1 — original trigger 10dvh + top margin 100dvh
options.scrub: Delay (seconds), default true (immediate) — a smooth-scroll library already adds delay
options.copy: Distance the two title lines slide out (vh), default 100 · 0 leaves the title in place

use:
Left vertical column

Right Vertical Line

— Step count equals the number of photos on one side (the last photo peels away together with a half panel). The section shown afterward sits beneath the panel

from.where: index.html .lp-fv (Hero — three photos per half, two vertical titles)
from.note: The original clears a fixed panel with three in-flow triggers. The part gives the same spot with a single sticky stage
